title: the WSG uncontrollable fires slice - the fire discipline rules, the spark and wild-fire ladder, the extinguishing semantics and the spread prose, printed p. 67
audit_label: R476 WSG uncontrollable fires pin audit
audit_comment: The fire discipline rules (no oversize with the two-small-fires advice, never untended with the sentry watch), the spark cadence with the carry ladder and the catch chance, the average-case growth ladder with the six-turn uncontrollable bar, the extinguishing times with the halving, water and combustible-doubling semantics and the residual and flare-up chances, and the uncontrollable-fire spread prose are audit examples.

banner.title: R476: the WSG UNCONTROLLABLE FIRES slice, printed p. 67 - the sixth camping-arc round, riding the precautions-and-perils seam unpinned by R475 (whose box stopped at the first cardinal rule): the four cardinal rules of fire discipline (the do-not-oversize rule with the two-small-fires advice; the never-leave-untended rule with the sentry spark watch), the spark semantics (sparks and ash once every 1d3 turns, carried downwind 10-30 feet by fire size plus one foot per 1 mph of wind, a 1 in 6 catch chance on combustible material, the wild fire that may grow into a blaze charring the terrain for several miles), the spread adjudication (minutes in strong wind on dry fuel, self-death in calm on sparse or wet material), the average-case growth ladder (tiny flame to small fire in 1 turn, to medium in 2, to large in 4, uncontrollable within 6 turns - one hour - either by height or by area), the extinguishing discipline (5 rounds for a small fire on bare ground, 1 turn for a medium, 2 turns for a large, halved by a second character or by 1, 2 or 4 gallons of water, doubled on combustible material, a 1 in 10 residual chance, and the 2d4-turn flare-up of a campfire left alive), and the uncontrollable fires prose (the spread while in contact with fuel, the rainstorm-or-created-water stop, the rough circle that strings out into a line or wall of fire advancing with the wind, and the animals and wise characters fleeing ahead), printed p. 67.
banner.provenance: Ground truth two-way clean on every number, no contested cells, no physical-page reads: the user-run Termux tesseract text of printed p. 67 (p67_full.txt, p67_tsv.tsv) vs the pdf embedded text layer (pdftotext -layout, pdf page 68, p67_pdfy.txt). The two readers AGREE on all prose numbers: the 1d3 spark cadence with the 10-20-30 foot carry ladder and the 1-foot-per-mph wind add, the 1 in 6 catch chance, the 1-2-4 growth ladder with the 6-turn (one hour) uncontrollable bar, the 5-rounds-1-turn-2-turns extinguishing times with the halving rule and the 1-2-4 gallon water amounts, the doubled time on combustible material with the 1 in 10 residual chance, and the 2d4-turn flare-up. The page carries NO table (the user confirmed the earlier two-table report was an off-by-one against the neighbouring page), so no vision-on-png settler was needed this round.
banner.sentinel: All prose numbers of printed p. 67 pinned (the spark cadence, the carry ladder, the catch chance, the growth ladder, the extinguishing times, the water amounts, the residual and flare-up chances); the cardinal rules, the spread adjudication and the uncontrollable-fire prose are audit examples.

consts.name: wcfSparkDieSides
consts.comment: a campfire throws off sparks and ash once every 1d3 turns

consts.name: wcfSparkCarrySmallFt
consts.comment: the bits of flame from a small fire are carried 10 feet

consts.name: wcfSparkCarryMediumFt
consts.comment: the bits of flame from a medium fire are carried 20 feet

consts.name: wcfSparkCarryLargeFt
consts.comment: the bits of flame from a large fire are carried 30 feet

consts.name: wcfSparkWindFtPerMph
consts.comment: the carry distance gains one foot for every 1 mph of wind velocity

consts.name: wcfCatchRoll
consts.comment: sparks landing on combustible material catch on fire on a roll of 1

consts.name: wcfCatchDie
consts.comment: on 1d6: a 1 in 6 chance the material catches on fire

consts.name: wcfGrowthSmallTurns
consts.comment: in an average case a tiny flame grows into a small fire in 1 turn

consts.name: wcfGrowthMediumTurns
consts.comment: the small fire grows into a medium fire in 2 turns

consts.name: wcfGrowthLargeTurns
consts.comment: the medium fire grows into a large fire in 4 turns

consts.name: wcfUncontrollableTurns
consts.comment: a fire not extinguished within 6 turns grows to uncontrollable size

consts.name: wcfTurnsPerHour
consts.comment: the six turns of the uncontrollable bar are one hour: six turns per hour

consts.name: wcfRoundsPerTurn
consts.comment: ten rounds per turn, the small-fire extinguishing unit boundary

consts.name: wcfExtinguishSmallRounds
consts.comment: a single character extinguishes a small fire on bare ground in 5 rounds

consts.name: wcfExtinguishMediumTurns
consts.comment: a medium fire is extinguished in the same way in 1 turn

consts.name: wcfExtinguishLargeTurns
consts.comment: a large fire is put out in 2 turns

consts.name: wcfHalveDivisor
consts.comment: the extinguishing time is cut in half with a helper or water

consts.name: wcfWaterSmallGal
consts.comment: 1 gallon of water suffices for a small fire

consts.name: wcfWaterMediumGal
consts.comment: 2 gallons of water suffice for a medium fire

consts.name: wcfWaterLargeGal
consts.comment: 4 gallons of water suffice for a large fire

consts.name: wcfCombustibleTimeMult
consts.comment: a fire built on top of combustible material takes twice as long to extinguish

consts.name: wcfResidualRoll
consts.comment: even with all proper precautions a combustible-built fire may not be fully out on a 1

consts.name: wcfResidualDie
consts.comment: on 1d10: a 1 in 10 chance of incomplete extinguishing

consts.name: wcfFlareDice
consts.comment: a campfire left alive flares up in 2d4 turns

consts.name: wcfFlareDieSides
consts.comment: the flare-up die is d4

bools.name: wcfNoOversizeRule
bools.comment: the second cardinal rule: do not build a larger fire than you need

bools.name: wcfTwoSmallFiresBetter
bools.comment: it is usually better to build two small fires instead of one medium fire

bools.name: wcfSmallerEasierControl
bools.comment: smaller fires are easier to control and can be extinguished more quickly

bools.name: wcfNeverLeaveUntended
bools.comment: the third cardinal rule: never leave a fire untended

bools.name: wcfSentryWatchesFire
bools.comment: the primary duty of a sentry is to be alert for threats, including sparks and bits of glowing ash

bools.name: wcfWildFireCanGrow
bools.comment: a wild fire not extinguished promptly may grow into a large blaze charring the terrain for several miles

bools.name: wcfDmAdjudicatesSpread
bools.comment: how quickly and how far a fire spreads is determined by the Dungeon Master depending on the circumstances

bools.name: wcfStrongWindMinutes
bools.comment: with very strong wind, very dry combustible material and plenty of fuel the fire reaches uncontrollable proportions in a matter of minutes

bools.name: wcfCalmMayDie
bools.comment: with calm wind and very sparse or very wet material the fire may go out by itself

bools.name: wcfUncontrollableByHeightOrArea
bools.comment: uncontrollable size comes either from the height of the blaze or from the area it covers

bools.name: wcfExtinguishMethod
bools.comment: extinguishing means stirring and separating the ashes, stamping on the larger burning pieces and covering the remains with dirt

bools.name: wcfHelperHalvesTime
bools.comment: the extinguishing time is cut in half if a second character assists

bools.name: wcfWaterHalvesTime
bools.comment: the extinguishing time is also cut in half if a sufficient amount of water is sprinkled or poured on the embers

bools.name: wcfCombustibleDoublesTime
bools.comment: the time needed to extinguish a fire built on combustible material is twice as long, because the material beneath must also be separated and stirred

bools.name: wcfResidualRisk
bools.comment: even with all proper precautions there is a 1 in 10 chance a fire built on combustible material is not completely extinguished

bools.name: wcfLeftAliveFlares
bools.comment: a campfire left alive flares up after the characters leave the area and may spread to the surrounding terrain

bools.name: wcfSpreadWhileFuelContact
bools.comment: an out-of-control fire spreads and grows as long as it remains in contact with fuel

bools.name: wcfOutsideForceStops
bools.comment: the spread continues until an outside force such as a rainstorm or magically created water slows it or puts it out

bools.name: wcfRoughCircleFirst
bools.comment: the fire fans out from where it started, at first burning in a rough circle

bools.name: wcfStringsOutToWall
bools.comment: the fire gradually strings out until it becomes a line or wall of fire advancing in the direction of the wind

bools.name: wcfWiseFlee
bools.comment: animals and wise characters flee from the path of the fire, running ahead of it

examples.note: the spark cadence: 1d3 turns, the 10-20-30 foot carry ladder and the 1-foot-per-mph wind add
examples.expr: m['wcfSparkDieSides']() != 3 or m['wcfSparkCarrySmallFt']() != 10 or m['wcfSparkCarryMediumFt']() != 20 or m['wcfSparkCarryLargeFt']() != 30 or m['wcfSparkWindFtPerMph']() != 1

examples.note: the catch chance is 1 in 6 on combustible material
examples.expr: m['wcfCatchRoll']() != 1 or m['wcfCatchDie']() != 6 or m['wcfCatchRoll']() >= m['wcfCatchDie']()

examples.note: the average-case growth ladder: tiny to small in 1 turn, to medium in 2, to large in 4
the ladder is strictly increasing and the uncontrollable bar sits strictly beyond the large step
examples.expr: m['wcfGrowthSmallTurns']() >= m['wcfGrowthMediumTurns']() or m['wcfGrowthMediumTurns']() >= m['wcfGrowthLargeTurns']() or m['wcfGrowthLargeTurns']() >= m['wcfUncontrollableTurns']()

examples.note: the 6-turn uncontrollable bar is exactly one hour at six turns per hour
examples.expr: m['wcfUncontrollableTurns']() != 6 or m['wcfTurnsPerHour']() != 6 or m['wcfUncontrollableTurns']() != m['wcfTurnsPerHour']()

examples.note: the extinguishing times: 5 rounds for a small fire, 1 turn for a medium, 2 turns for a large
examples.expr: m['wcfExtinguishSmallRounds']() != 5 or m['wcfExtinguishMediumTurns']() != 1 or m['wcfExtinguishLargeTurns']() != 2 or m['wcfHalveDivisor']() != 2

examples.note: the extinguishing times are strictly increasing measured in rounds
examples.expr: m['wcfRoundsPerTurn']() != 10 or m['wcfExtinguishMediumTurns']() * m['wcfRoundsPerTurn']() <= m['wcfExtinguishSmallRounds']() or m['wcfExtinguishLargeTurns']() <= m['wcfExtinguishMediumTurns']()

examples.note: the water amounts: 1, 2 and 4 gallons, each size doubling the previous
examples.expr: m['wcfWaterSmallGal']() != 1 or m['wcfWaterMediumGal']() != 2 or m['wcfWaterLargeGal']() != 4 or m['wcfWaterMediumGal']() != 2 * m['wcfWaterSmallGal']() or m['wcfWaterLargeGal']() != 2 * m['wcfWaterMediumGal']()

examples.note: the combustible-material doubling and the 1-in-10 residual chance
examples.expr: m['wcfCombustibleTimeMult']() != 2 or m['wcfResidualRoll']() != 1 or m['wcfResidualDie']() != 10 or m['wcfResidualRoll']() >= m['wcfResidualDie']()
